_comment: Pinned versions for the business-de skills. Re-verify on every spec/validator bump; record the re-verification date in the skill's references/SOURCES.md. Never hardcode a version inside scripts or SKILL.md - read it from this file.

en16931.note: EN 16931-1:2017 with Corrigendum 2017-06 (v1.2.4). Factur-X profile model follows this version. Re-verify before any KoSIT validator upgrade.

factur-x.note: CORRECTED 2026-10-08 (PASS 2 re-verification): FNFE-MPE site now advertises 'Publication de Factur-X 1.09.2 / ZUGFeRD 2.5.2' (http://fnfe-mpe.org/factur-x/, retrieved 2026-10-08, HTTP 200). The previous pin of 1.0.11 is stale. This is the *spec* version; the akretion/factur-x *library* tag (7.4) is pinned separately. Re-verify on every release.

kosit-validator.note: CORRECTED 2026-10-08: tag v2026-08-31 confirmed present in the GitHub tags API (commit b436fc4). Older tags xrechnung-1_1-2017-12-19 and xrechnung-1_1-2018-02-12 also present. No public version page; tag date is the pin.

ustg_obligation.note: e-invoicing obligation for B2B in Germany. Re-verify against BMF Schreiben of 2024-11-15 before relying on transitional rules.

factur-x-spec.note: FNFE-MPE Factur-X specification version. CORRECTED 2026-10-08: 1.09.2 per the FNFE site. COMFORT profile = EN 16931 for B2B.

beg_iv.note: CORRECTED 2026-10-08 (PASS 2 re-verification): the BEG URL (https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/beg/) now resolves to the *Bundesentschädigungsgesetz* (BEG = Entschädigung für Opfer der NS-Verfolgung), NOT the Aufbewahrungsfristen. The retention classes actually live in AO §147 Abs. 3 n.F. (effective 2025-01-01, geändert durch Art. 3 G. v. 23.10.2024 BGBl. 2024 I Nr. 323). Re-verified 2026-10-08 against dejure.org/gesetze/AO/147.html (200, statute text: Bücher/Jahresabschluss 10 Jahre, Buchungsbelege 8 Jahre, Handels-/Geschäftsbriefe 6 Jahre) and provimedia.de/blog/aufbewahrungsfristen (200, 'Seit 2025: Belege 8 Jahre, Bücher 10 Jahre, Geschäftsbriefe 6 Jahre'). The canonical AO URL returned 404 at retrieval. Let the tax advisor confirm per entity.

gobd_2014.note: Superseded GoBD principles retained for older retention periods. Re-verify against BMF Schreiben of 2024-11-15.

ao147.note: CORRECTED 2026-10-08 (PASS 2 re-verification): AO §147 Abs. 3 n.F. (effective 2025-01-01). dejure.org/gesetze/AO/147.html returned 200 with the statute text; gesetze-im-internet.de/ao/ returned 404 at retrieval. Classes: 10y Bücher/Jahresabschlüsse, 8y Buchungsbelege, 6y Handels-/Geschäftsbriefe/sonstige Unterlagen. Corroborated by provimedia.de (2026-07-11 post) and whk-controlling.de (modified 2026-04-14).

extf_schema.note: EXTF Versionsnummer=700, Formatversion=13 for Buchungsstapel (125 columns). Formatversion 10-12 are warnings; 13 is the current. EXTF_AS_OF 2026-09-25 per the seamless-engineering validator. DATEV does not publish a public version page; mark as unverified until DATEV confirms via the Prüfprogramm. Re-verify on every integration test run.

extf_formatkennzeichen.note: Field 1 of the header. DTVF is the legacy alternative.

kontenrahmen.note: Pinned default Kontenrahmen for Ottili GmbH. SKR03 is the alternative for GmbH & Co. KG. Re-verify against DATEV/IDR before each build; the account list is stable, the tax keys are not.

ust_rates_2026.note: Rates valid for 2026. EU ViDA may change them from 2027-01-01 (secondary source, verify). Read from this file; never hardcode in scripts.

am_konten.note: Automatikkonten per SKR; EXTF_AS_OF 2026-09-25. A BU-Schluessel other than '40' on these is rejected or double-counted by DATEV.

kleinunternehmer_threshold.note: Turnover threshold for the previous calendar year. Re-verify before each build; unchanged for years.

reverse_charge.note: Schuldnerschaft for certain services (IT, consulting, construction). The buyer bears the VAT debt; the buyer's USt-IdNr. is mandatory.

oss.note: OSS for EU distance sales of goods and services. EU ViDA changes planned from 2027-01-01 (secondary source, verify).

rounding.note: Highest-error-rate area in German VAT. Never round the total before the tax split.

camt053_version.note: Version 14 expected ~2026-09; re-verify before each build.

mt940_version.note: No public version page; mark as unverified until SWIFT confirms.

iban_rules.note: German IBANs use a country-specific check-digit algorithm, not generic mod-97.

duplicate_rule.note: Strict primary definition; a 5-day amount+reference window is a configurable heuristic, disabled by default.

dhl_api.note: DHL Parcel DE REST API catalogue. No public version page; the catalogue URL is the pin. Re-verify against developer.dhl.com before every build.

idempotency_header.note: Per-carrier idempotency field names differ; abstract behind a per-carrier adapter. Never assume one header name.

tracking_endpoints.note: Official tracking endpoints only. Never scrape the public tracking page.

cache_ttl_seconds.note: Tracking cache TTL. Carriers rate-limit tracking aggressively; 5 minutes is the safe default. Read by scripts/track.py, never hardcode.

signature_algorithm.note: Stable (NIST SP 800-38B). Secret key >= 256 bits; rotate on compromise.

github_signature_header.note: X-Hub-Signature (SHA1) is deprecated; never fall back.

stripe_replay_window_minutes.note: Stripe timestamp is part of the signature; reject outside the window before the HMAC check.

dedupe_ttl_hours.note: Configurable per provider; default 24h. Pin in config.

wordpress_rest_api.note: Basic Auth deprecated in WP 6.7+ (core); plugin ships separately and is unmaintained. Prefer Application Passwords or OAuth2.

meta_graph_api_version.note: Meta sunsets versions silently; pin the version and re-verify quarterly. Never hardcode in scripts.

gdpr_regulation.note: Re-check EUR-Lex before each build. Article 30 processing register, Article 6 legal bases.

eu_ai_act_regulation.note: Article 5(4) human oversight; Article 50 transparency obligations. Implementing acts still being adopted.

human_review_retention_years.note: Inherited from the gobd-archive GoBD retention class (label artefacts are business records under HGB/AO). GDPR does not fix a number.
